trades.reasoning: Top score with all four confirming signals (MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) and RSI still in the bullish 55-70 zone on a risk-on day.
Strong bullish crossover with price above SMA-20 and a volume surge confirming institutional buying interest.
Bullish MACD crossover with volume confirmation and RSI 59.3 leaves more room to run before overbought than peers like LIVN.

decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.4% and S&P 500 +1.6% confirm a broad risk-on day, so per our strategy of deploying idle cash into confirmed setups, we filled all 3 open slots with OUST, KD, and AUGO — each showing multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) with RSI still below overbought territory. Existing positions are held unchanged since none are showing exit signals and the market trend favors staying invested.

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posting gains above 1%, reflecting renewed risk appetite among investors. The breadth of the move across sectors suggests improving sentiment rather than a narrow tech-only bounce. This kind of broad-based strength is often a signal that institutional money is rotating back into growth and momentum names.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍造好，納指及標普500指數同告上升超過1%，反映投資者風險胃納回升。此次升市涵蓋多個行業,顯示市場氣氛整體改善，而非單靠科技股獨力支撐。這種闔市性的強勢通常意味著機構資金正重新流入增長及動力股。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, on the theory that strong price action tends to continue in the near term. Today we used multiple technical signals together — MACD crossovers, RSI, and volume surges — to confirm that the buying pressure behind our picks was genuine rather than a random spike.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動力投資是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，理論基礎是強勢的價格走勢短期內傾向延續。今天我們結合多項技術指標——MACD黃金交叉、RSI及成交量突增——來確認所選股票背後的買盤是真實的機構動力，而非偶然的短暫波動。
